'''Danah Jor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
In [[3643 BBY]] he came to the ruins of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to battle Force-sensitive [[nekghoul]]s, only to discover that they were being trained in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bay-Yon Siu]]. Misguided, Siu ordered the nekghouls to imprison Jor, who remained restrained until a Republic hero came by and activated the holocron. Jor urged the Republic citizen to destroy nekghouls with a radiation spike, while the holocron [[Gatekeeper/Legends|Gatekeeper]] urged to let them stay and be trained in the Force. Ultimately, Danah Jor was freed from his cage and he and his rescuer departed the Temple ruins.

==Behind the scenes==
Danah Jor is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Troy Hall]].
